QuestInfo.0: Maybe Dad would know what Mir likes. Talk to Dad.
QuestInfo.1: Dad says that if he is still a baby then maybe he should be drinking #bmilk#k. He says that you should ask for some milk from the #b#p1013105##k at the #b#m100030310##k.
QuestInfo.2: You started talking to #p1013105#. Now ask for some milk.

0.0: He's so big I didn't realize he was a baby. He probably can't digest meat yet. My guess is that all #bbabies need milk#k first.

yes.0: You can get milk from the #b#p1013105##k at the #b#m100030310##k. Why don't you go ask her to give you some?
yes.1: Oh, and once you're done feeding the lizard, can you come back to me? I have something to talk to you about.

no.0: Hmm... I think most babies are the same. Think about it and let me know if you change your mind.

npc.0: Have you not gone to the #p1013105# yet? She may be big but she's very gentle, so ask her to give you some milk.
